stable.notes: Session lookup stops throwing away the server's answer. Control gave the server two seconds to respond to a search; that route takes one and a half to two and a half, so whether you got the real ranked answer or a local keyword scan came down to timing. It now waits fifteen. And when it does fall back, it says why: a missing token, an unreachable server and a genuinely old one all used to report "this server is too old", which sent you looking for an update that was never the problem. Also included since 0.5.45: a forked conversation and the thread it came from are no longer shown as one row, and the Release button on a fenced thread can no longer be dismissed out from under itself. Needs COS Glasses server 6.36.11.
